questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true regarding shallow and deep wells?

options.label: A
options.text: Shallow wells tap water from underneath the first impervious layer and are not liable for contamination.

options.label: B
options.text: Deep wells yield limited quantities of water and usually dry up during summer.

options.label: C
options.text: Shallow wells are more likely to get contaminated and yield limited quantities of water.

options.label: D
options.text: Deep wells are easier and cheaper to construct compared to shallow wells.
